name: capture_and_describe_monitors
description: Capture and describe one or more monitor screenshots, then write a concise desktop activity snippet.

inputs.name: monitor_indices
inputs.description: Ordered monitor indices to capture and describe (1-based).

inputs.name: question
inputs.description: Optional question passed to vision_image_describe for each screenshot.

inputs.name: output_file_path
inputs.description: Path for the generated snippet when write_output is true.

inputs.name: write_output
inputs.description: Whether to overwrite output_file_path with the snippet.

inputs.name: ensure_newline
inputs.description: Ensure trailing newline when writing output.

arguments_prompt:
Arguments:
{
  "monitor_indices": [2, 3],
  "question": "In 1-2 concise sentences, describe what Jukka is doing on this monitor right now.",
  "output_file_path": "resources/dayflow_pipeline_outputs/resource_desktop_activity_recent.md",
  "write_output": true,
  "ensure_newline": true
}
